svg.text: CleverHand bus — lines, controller, nodes and what the master does with each line
master = COM module (or CTRL in mono/head role)
bus lines cross the master; only the taps below are read
shared lines pass straight through; only the master reads A0…A4, SDA/SCL, STOP
master = COM module (or CTRL in mono/head role)
bus lines cross the master; only the taps below are read
shared lines pass straight through; only the master reads A0…A4, SDA/SCL, STOP
Selection rule: set A0…A4 = n while SPI and I²C are idle,
wait ≥ 1 µs, then talk to node n. A0…A4 = 0 selects nobody.
Enumeration: all nodes hold SDA low; controller pulses SCL
with STOP high once then low; each node latches its count
when STOP_IN falls → node n gets address n, releases SDA.
